sources.source_format: Extracted text of draft Table II

sources.metric_scope: Primary NDCG@10/Cov@10 only. Test split and GRPO method confirmed by the data provider; Last columns excluded. Starting stages follow sheet labels; seed and SFT loss weight are unreported.

sources.deduplication: Latest snapshot contains every earlier cumulative and early-report CE source identity, with unchanged twelve test metrics; select latest once. Distinct configurations retained even when selected initial checkpoint makes metric values equal.
sources.initialization_limitations: Referenced per-run result and resolved-config files are not locally available. Initialization stage is supported, but exact per-run starting-checkpoint SHA is not verified; initial_checkpoint_id remains empty.

sources.deduplication: Unique configuration_id in source; retain each completed CE configuration once. Equal metrics for different configurations are not collapsed.
sources.metric_precision: Preserve numeric XML cell values from the source workbook.
sources.initialization: SFT-only starting checkpoints identified by source SHA256.
sources.selection_point: Test metrics for the validation-NDCG@5-selected checkpoint, including retained initial checkpoints.

source_policy: Authored summary selections and per-run candidate selections remain separate evidence. Preserve historical authored GRPO/CE results and add new GRPO/CE candidate groups in explicit source namespaces; unknown run identities are not merged or used to replace historical aggregates.

reported_selection.basis: Source workbook labels, not rankings recomputed from the partial candidate grid.
reported_selection.pareto: Nondominated NDCG@10/Coverage@10 frontier, min-max normalization over that frontier, nearest to (1,1) with equal weights; ties prefer NDCG@10.
reported_selection.initialization_scope: GFlow and CE separate initializations; Prefix-CE and Q-MSE pool tuned and SFT-only initializations, as recorded in selection_scope.
reported_selection.uncertainty: Reported mean plus/minus Student-t 95% CI half-width according to the sheet-level note (LOO setting!A238). Seed identifiers and counts are retained where explicitly available; intervals are not recomputed.

candidate_selection.aggregation: None. Individual source records and calibration protocols remain distinct. GRPO seed and repetition identities are unreported; seed42 is supplied for the original tracker and both CE sources.
candidate_selection.tie_policy: Choose a stable representative using the other metric then source row; publish tie counts. The three selectors may choose the same record.
missing_metadata: checkpoint/split identities for the original tracker and GRPO
initial checkpoint SHA for exp7 CE
GRPO seed, SFT loss weight, checkpoint-selection criterion and other metrics
candidate_selection.ce_configuration_scope: Exact/sampled estimators, sampling methods, CE targets and importance correction are configuration choices within a source protocol; all are retained as scientific parameters. The pooled selection is descriptive, not a controlled estimator comparison.

transformations: Retain only the three article datasets and LOO reported summary; exclude Global setting, Beauty 2023 and Yambda 500M.
Retain numeric scientific values and confidence-interval strings without recomputing reported means.
Join candidate registry IDs to sampling and SFT weights; preserve each source row and calibration variant.
Export all candidate rows, including rows hidden by source filters.
Retain only whitelisted scientific settings; omit operational sheets, comments, hyperlinks, local paths, personnel and execution status.
Do not average repeated seed-42 records or reinterpret reported confidence intervals as standard deviations.
Retain seed identifiers and counts explicitly stated in scientific comments as structured parameters; omit the comment text.

Import 48 GRPO primary test pairs from Base/SFT tuned, expanding merged dataset/model labels; exclude Last columns, preserve source reward labels and the explicitly reported beta without inferring its semantics.

Import exp7 CE from the latest cumulative CSV only: all earlier reported CE identities are present and shared test metrics are unchanged. Retain distinct configurations even if the selected initial checkpoint makes their metrics identical.

Import 224 completed CE rows for the three datasets from the SFT-only workbook results sheet; preserve source numeric XML cell values, starting-checkpoint SHA256 and scientific protocol fields. Exclude unrelated arms, datasets and history/events sheets.
Keep historical authored summaries and new candidate selections in distinct source namespaces; do not add new GRPO rows to historical mean/CI estimates.
Candidate structured parameters and source references use explicit public-field allowlists; no checkpoint paths, run directories or source operational records are exported.
Exclude DPO and S-DPO method records from this paper-scoped fork; retain other scientific values and stable record identifiers unchanged.

main_selection.reported_rows: Retain source selections whose pools do not mix initializations, with namespace reported_summary.
main_selection.prefix_ce_and_q_mse: Replace the source pooled-initialization selections with per-initialization selections from the supplied candidate records. Preserve separate source batches and calibration protocols.
main_selection.original_pooled_selections: Retain unchanged in reported_selections.csv for provenance, outside the main selected_metrics.csv.
main_selection.scope_limit: Recomputed selections are only best within the supplied partial candidate groups; they do not establish the best configuration over an unavailable full experiment grid.
main_selection.grpo_and_ce: Retain authored GRPO/CE selections in reported_summary and add per-source GRPO/CE candidate selections, with starting stages kept separate. Do not infer duplicate runs or matching uncertainty from rounded metrics.

ce_report_snapshots.timing_limitations: One resumed exact CE run reports duration of the latest invocation only. init_kept is a completed CE run selected at epoch zero, not an additional independent baseline.
